requirement: A finished import leaves no resume pointer behind, and a claim no start can still be on its way under no longer refuses every later import

oracle.ref: PR #1679 (fix); fix evidence: Dev pass 24/10/2026 (#1664): the Add site tab kept showing 'Building … Getting a machine ready…' for an import whose job was already done/ready, because the pointer written while the read ran was cleared only by a `handed_over` step that never lands once the build console replaces the wizard. (#1665): an import started within 15 min of a Remove was refused with 'This import is being removed…' and left an accepted row with no run (RUN_UNKNOWN); every later start answered claim_stands until DELETE /api/sites/:key/import removed the row; a start cut off by a redeploy left the same row.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. #1664: in the creation workspace, where the handover swaps the import wizard for the build console, the resume pointer `tracy.import.active` is gone after the handover — host-filed, wizard-filed, or a manual handover retry — and Add site opened again shows the clean form and follows no finished run. #1664: a read still going when the tab closed is offered again on reopen (Follow it), followed, handed over, and its pointer then cleared (C3). #1665: the claim door answers a press that finds its claim standing with `idleMs`, the time since the press before on the server's clock (from the row's birth when no press was recorded), and the press is still the activity the abandoned-import sweep reads. #1665: a start the hold refused (IMPORT_REMOVING), then the page opened again, starts under the claim once it sat idle for UNANSWERED_START_MS with no build job and no run on the host; a start a redeploy cut off is followed by Start again that sends a start; no claim is deleted from the wizard. #1665 no second read: every start carries its claim press (strictly increasing, the row locked per press) and a take-over names the press it supersedes; the host answers the site's latest run, opening none, to a start whose press a run already carries or a newer one, or to a take-over when a run carries a press at or before the one it supersedes (A late, B pressed with no start, C took over: one read) — a start delayed past another tab's ended read (either order), the same press twice, and the same after a restart from runs.json; a newer press, Retry and Continue still open a run. #1665 guard kept: a claim pressed less than the wait ago, with a build job, with no idle time named, whose site has a finished read, or whose status is unreadable sends no start; an idle claim whose read is live is followed, never started twice; a start still on its way when the wizard reopens sends no second start. Related flows unchanged: Remove during a read is refused (IMPORT_RUNNING), the hold refuses every start until the deletion is done, the host handover (#1652) is followed, filing none.
